improvements.rationale: Search engines and social platforms rely on meta descriptions and OG tags to generate previews. A clear, benefit-focused meta description improves click-through rates from Google results, while OG tags ensure LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook display a professional, branded preview when the link is shared. Including the free trial offer and starting price creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try 3 free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces Gideon by name, establishing brand identity while clearly stating its core function. The subheading reinforces the three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) and removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no commitment. The structure moves visitors from understanding what Gideon is to taking action.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and full trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model: what happens when the trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, it reduces uncertainty, sets expectations, and gently reinforces the value and affordability of membership—helping convert trial users into paying members.
